top_signals.title: UK economy surprises again but slowdown incoming
top_signals.summary: The UK economy grew 0.4 per cent between April and June, official data has revealed, although prospects are set to dim over the rest of the year.  The Office for National Statistics revealed that the quarterly reading came alongside a surprise growth figure of 0.3 per cent in June, topping analyst’s expectations. top_signals.title: Optimism grows for broader Japanese stocks amid chip concerns
'Nobody wants it': Lettuce prices see record-setting plunge as cyclospora spooks consumers
top_signals.summary: Lettuce prices posted their sharpest month-over-month decline on record as diners reconsider the vegetable amid the cyclospora outbreak.

top_signals.title: U.S. budget deficit surged in July to highest level since March 2021
top_signals.summary: Beyond the big single-month jump, the collective red ink over the 10 months of the fiscal year rose to nearly $1.8 trillion, surpassing the same period in 2025.
